title: Guard Duty (easy)
statementMd:
The Rebel fleet is afraid that the Empire might want to strike back again. Princess Heidi needs to know if it is possible to assign $*R*$ Rebel spaceships to guard $*B*$ bases so that every base has exactly one guardian and each spaceship has exactly one assigned base (in other words, the assignment is a perfect matching). Since she knows how reckless her pilots are, she wants to be sure that any two (straight) paths – from a base to its assigned spaceship – do not intersect in the galaxy plane (that is, in 2D), and so there is no risk of collision.

## Input

The first line contains two space-separated integers $*R*, *B*(1 ≤ *R*, *B* ≤ 10)$. For $1 ≤ *i* ≤ *R*$, the $*i* + 1$-th line contains two space-separated integers $*x*_{*i*}$ and $*y*_{*i*}$ ($|*x*_{*i*}|, |*y*_{*i*}| ≤ 10000$) denoting the coordinates of the $*i*$-th Rebel spaceship. The following $*B*$ lines have the same format, denoting the position of bases. It is guaranteed that no two points coincide and that no three points are on the same line.

## Output

If it is possible to connect Rebel spaceships and bases so as satisfy the constraint, output `Yes`, otherwise output `No` (without quote).

## Note

For the first example, one possible way is to connect the Rebels and bases in order.

For the second example, there is no perfect matching between Rebels and bases.
statementZhMd:
叛军舰队担心帝国可能会再次发动反击。Heidi 公主需要知道，是否可以安排 $*R*$ 艘叛军飞船守卫 $*B*$ 个基地，使得每个基地恰好有一艘守卫飞船，并且每艘飞船恰好被分配到一个基地（换句话说，这种分配是一个完美匹配）。由于她知道飞行员们有多么鲁莽，她希望确保任意两条从基地到其对应飞船的（直线）路径都不会在银河平面（即二维平面）中相交，从而避免发生碰撞。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*R*, *B*(1 ≤ *R*, *B* ≤ 10)$。对于 $1 ≤ *i* ≤ *R*$，接下来的第 $*i* + 1$ 行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*x*_{*i*} 和 $*y*_{*i*}（|*x*_{*i*}|, |*y*_{*i*}| ≤ 10000），表示第 $*i*$ 艘叛军飞船的坐标。接下来的 $*B*$ 行格式相同，表示基地的位置。保证任意两个点不重合，并且不存在三个点共线。

## 输出格式

如果可以连接叛军飞船和基地，使其满足上述条件，则输出 `Yes`，否则输出 `No`（不含引号）。

## 说明

对于第一个样例，一种可行的方法是按照顺序连接叛军飞船和基地。

对于第二个样例，叛军飞船和基地之间不存在完美匹配。
